description: Your ERC-8183 escrow on BNB Chain at a glance, for any wallet (an agent's provider wallet or a buyer's): every job it sells or buys on the kernel with what happens next to each (waiting for delivery until …, in the dispute window until …, window over: pay waiting to be released, expired undelivered: money waiting to come back), the totals of pay waiting release and money waiting refund, and what BOBAI's free public settle (releases delivered jobs' pay to providers) and public refund (returns undelivered jobs' budgets to clients) already did for it, with transactions. Read-only, free. Job states as of the daily read at 21:45 UTC.

address.description: the wallet: 0x + 40 hex (a provider, an agentWallet, or a client)

name: erc8183_escrow_status
